slot_scores.name: purchase_at_month_start
slot_scores.evidence_quote: For the inventory balance in each month, does the purchase happen before the sale (so you can sell units bought in the same month), or does the sale happen before the purchase (so you can only sell from stock carried in from the previous month)?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the timing of purchases relative to sales within the month, covering the hidden slot's key meaning.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden P1 slot was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; no unresolved P0 or P1 slots remained.

summary: The agent asked targeted questions that resolved the hidden purchase-timing slot and other key modeling details before stopping, resulting in an appropriate clarification process.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
